subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-authored configuration actions in SKILL.md metadata, and what URL trust policy should the dashboard enforce?
rationale: The implementation shape is bounded, but accepting arbitrary skill-provided configuration URLs changes public skill metadata and dashboard trust semantics.

options.title: Approve typed config action
options.body: Add a generic configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

options.title: Use existing link surfaces
options.body: Keep `homepage`, Skill Card, and ClawHub pages as the supported configuration discovery path for now.

options.title: Prototype outside core first
options.body: Let ClawHub or Skill Card metadata carry configuration links before committing to a core dashboard action.

recommendation.title: Approve typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a generic configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the current Skills page and shared dashboard URL policy surface where recent history points to shakkernerd.
